status: APPLIED. The owner authorized this batch on 2026-10-12; approval {by: Jody Tyree, at: 2026-10-12} is recorded on all 76 records. Nothing is merged or deployed.

action.wording: AUTHORIZE PUBLICATION APPROVAL: batch seasonal-release-1, all 76 records, approved by <name> on <YYYY-MM-DD>.
steps: For each of the 76 ids below, add approval {by: <name>, at: <YYYY-MM-DD>} to the record in entries.json and set status to PUBLISHED. Nothing else on the record changes.
Run node scripts/build-seasonal.js (writes seasonal/published-entries.js and the three pages) and the full test suite.
Commit and push to integration/halloween-consolidation; check CI and the Preview's public /fall and /fall-color without QA parameters.
Merging to main and the production deploy are separate authorizations.
action.note: Nothing in this repository writes `approval`. The proposed approval is not stored on any record until the approving person's authorization is given.
